elements.element: Vendor provides transition assistance on expiry or termination
elements.evidence: "Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, TrueLink shall (a) at Client's request, provide reasonable transition assistance"

elements.element: Transition assistance duration up to 6 months
Return of Customer Data within 30 days of expiry/termination

elements.element: Return in a standard machine-readable format
Deletion of Customer Data after return
elements.evidence: "(c) thereafter delete such Client Content and data from its systems"
"and certify such deletion to Client in writing"
"for up to six (6) months" exceeds the 90-day floor
"within thirty (30) days of such expiration or termination, return to Client all Client Content"

reasons: The inserted Section 14a supplies every preferred atomic element: assistance up to six months at then-current rates, 30-day return of Client data in a machine-readable format, and post-return deletion with written certification.

"commonly used, machine-readable format" is functionally the preferred "standard machine-readable format"; the two deterministic checks flagging format and the 30-day return as absent are contradicted by the operative text, which states both expressly.

The "at Client's request" condition attaches only to transition assistance (limb (a)); the data-return, deletion and certification duties in limbs (b) and (c) remain unconditional, so the request trigger does not swallow the mandatory return.

Insertion is a concise new clause addressing an absent obligation; no existing sentence of Sections 13-14 is altered, no defined term is disturbed, and "Client Content" is an existing document term, so no dangling mechanic or contradiction is created.
Minor qualifiers ("reasonable", "including borrower and loan data") narrow nothing material and merely scope the duty; noted rather than treated as offending extra words.
